minimum_fields: council_key, financial_year, fund, program_id, project_id, asset_id, work_type, ordinary_or_disaster, original_budget_aud, snapshot_budget_aud, snapshot_period_end, council_approval_date, source/page
coverage: Affected and comparison councils; pre-event original plan plus each within-year revision
purpose: Match fixed portfolio and identify actual timing of downward revisions

minimum_fields: same scope/IDs, actual_aud, cash_or_accrual, final_budget_aud, year_end, reconciliation_note
purpose: Measure annual delivery deviation and separate revision from execution

minimum_fields: old_code, new_code, effective_date, fund, capital_or_operating, renewal_or_new, reconstruction_flag, GST_basis, noncash_flag, overhead_rules, transfers/carryovers
purpose: Prevent relabelling or carryover from becoming apparent spending cuts

minimum_fields: council_key, AGRN/episode, local_impact_start/end, source/confidence, damage/access indicators, overlapping events, comparison exposure status
coverage: All selected councils and their entire observation windows
purpose: Place shocks relative to budget information and rule out contaminated controls

minimum_fields: council_key, measurement_end, reporting_months, variable/value/unit, definition, publication/adoption_date, source, restatement_vintage
coverage: Latest full pre-event period with known available source; do not replace missing with contemporaneous values
purpose: Certify temporal ordering and comparable capacity

minimum_fields: project_id, pre-event funded status, baseline budget, original milestone/due_date, revised due_date/budget, decision_date, actual_completion, delay/reduction reason, asset damaged/access status
coverage: Fixed pre-event portfolio, including projects not deferred
purpose: Separate cancellation, rephasing, financial diversion and direct physical disruption

minimum_fields: dated grant commitments/payments and restrictions; procurement/labour/access constraints; scope changes; cofunding
coverage: Selected projects/councils, collected only after core budget chain works
purpose: Explain competing mechanisms; post-event values not automatic adjustment controls
